text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Algeria celebrates the anniversary of its independence war: it was a triumph of the freedom ideal.
- The government raises tax on passport stamps.
- The state collects more than 3.0 billion dinars ($55 million) from tax disc this year.
- National Liberation Front (FLN) and Islamist Hamas compete to control newly created Former Fighters' Sons National Organisation leadership.
- The government sets up a special police unit to control pharmaceutical products.
